links.outcome: Blinded endocrinologist ratings comparing two candidate LLMs on accuracy, completeness, clarity, utility, satisfaction
links.effect: GPT-OSS-20B rated higher than MedGemma-27B-Instruct on all five criteria after Holm correction; Satisfaction median 5.0 vs 4.0 (RBC 0.788), Completeness 5.0 vs 4.0 (RBC 0.599).
links.quote: GPT-OSS-20B achieved higher question-level median ratings than MedGemma-27B-Instruct across all five criteria after Holm correction.

screen.reason: The study conducts an offline expert evaluation comparing two open-weight LLMs (general-purpose vs. medically specialized) for generating thyroid cancer patient education responses in Turkish, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
